(2) The toddler walks across the hardwood floor toward an electric fireplace that displays a flame animation. He holds the white tub with both hands. (3) The scene shifts to a white coffee table where several Teletubbies figurines are placed. The toddler stands nearby, interacting with the adult and pointing at objects. (4) The toddler moves to a different area of the room with a desk, office chair, and suitcases. He begins to dance energetically, swaying his body and waving the figurines in his hands. (5) In a closer shot, the toddler covers his face with his hands and then looks into the camera, mimicking a 'cute' pose as requested by the adult. (6) The toddler walks with his hands behind his back, imitating an older person's gait. (7) Returning to the couch area, the toddler attempts to look 'scary' by widening his eyes and smiling at the camera. (8) The final sequence shows the toddler sitting or leaning against the couch while the adult continues to prompt him with words. The video ends with a grayscale filter and a loading icon overlay.
